target: the basename shortcut must not treat two DIFFERENT files as the same. This repo has eight SKILL.md files; declaring one and naming another in an acceptance is genuine scope drift.
cmd:
printf -- "---
id: 1
title: t
status: queued
---

## Brief (the delegation contract)

" > b.md; printf -- "- **input_paths**: \`skills/spec/SKILL.md\`
- **output_spec**: x

" >> b.md; printf -- "## Acceptance (behavioral, testable)

1. It SHALL work.
   - Given \`skills/review/SKILL.md\`, when b, then c.
" >> b.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/spec_check.sh" b.md >/dev/null 2>&1; other=$?; printf -- "---
id: 1
title: t
status: queued
---

## Brief (the delegation contract)

" > s2.md; printf -- "- **input_paths**: \`scripts/lib/obs.sh\`
- **output_spec**: x

" >> s2.md; printf -- "## Acceptance (behavioral, testable)

1. It SHALL work.
   - Given \`obs.sh\`, when b, then c.
" >> s2.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/spec_check.sh" s2.md >/dev/null 2>&1; short=$?; printf '{"differentFile":%s,"shortForm":%s}' "$other" "$short"
